story: A support case (CS-200) needs to be escalated to engineering because the issue is a confirmed bug in the API integration. The agent should review the case details, escalate to the engineering team with a clear reason, and update the case status to reflect the escalation. This tests the escalation workflow without needing to create a new case.

args.resolution: Escalated to engineering for confirmed API bug
args.internal_notes: Bug confirmed by support team, assigned to senior engineer

starting_sentence: Escalate case CS-200 to the engineering team — the customer's issue is a confirmed bug
